spans.s:
Ukṣaṇyāyana is mentioned in a Dānastuti (‘Praise of Gifts’) in the Rigveda along with harayāṇa and suṣāman. Ludwig thinks that all three are identical. Roth finds a reference to ukṣan himself in the verb ukṣaṇyati and in the adjective ukṣaṇyu.
Foot notes viii. 25, 22.
Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 162, 270.
St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
Rv. viii. 26, 9.
Rv. viii. 23, 16.

Ukṣṇo-randhra Kāvya is mentioned as a seer in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa (xiii. 9, 19).
Foot notes Cf. Max Müller, Sacred Books of the East, 32, 397.
